description: Pins INSIDE the horizon-ciphertrust image (infra-ik4p.1): the Horizon base image (HORIZON_VERSION), the maven build image, the build plugins, javassist and our own tink-ciphertrust. Runs from mdapi/fleet's `renovate` job, which lists this repo in RENOVATE_REPOSITORIES. The readers (Dockerfile FROM, maven, the `# renovate:` ARG regex), the house core, OSV alerts and the dependency-proxy alias come from the shared preset local>mdapi/renovate-config:image-repo; do not set enabledManagers or postUpgradeTasks here, since a repo value REPLACES the preset's. MR-only baseline: nothing in this repo automerges until a graduation tick says so.
prBodyNotes: Tick one box to change what automerges for this dependency **from now on**. Windmill `f/desk/renovate_graduate` reads the ticks and labels on this repo's Renovate MRs and opens an MR against its `renovate.json`; nothing changes until that MR merges. The label is the durable form — `automerge:digest`, `automerge:minor`, `automerge:major`, `automerge:never` — and works on a merged MR too.
- [ ] <!--grad:{{{packageName}}}:digest--> automerge future **rebuilds of this tag** — digest: same version, new content  ·  label `automerge:digest`
⚠️ `digest` is deliberately NOT implied by the version ticks: on a pinned tag a digest is that release rebuilt, the base-image fix path. A merge here builds and pushes the horizon-ciphertrust image.

packageRules.description: The Horizon base (registry.evertrust.io, read with the Evertrust login on mdapi/fleet's renovate job). A merge builds a new image; it reaches no cluster until fleet's Horizon values pin the new immutable tag, and that bump goes with the Evertrust chart's appVersion. The provided jars stay pinned to what the image ships: the image build fails (check-provided-jars.sh) until pom.xml follows, so fix them in THIS branch.
prBodyNotes: #### Horizon base bump: what has to move with it

- If the `buildkit` job fails in `check-provided-jars.sh`, the new image ships other versions of the provided jars (tink, scala-library, slf4j-api): set them in `pom.xml` on THIS branch to what the error lists. Horizon 2.12.0, for one, moved tink 1.21.0 → 1.24.0 and slf4j-api 2.0.18 → 2.0.20.
- Merging only builds `<version>-b<iid>`. Rolling it out is the fleet Horizon values tag bump, together with the Evertrust chart's appVersion; re-run the RUNBOOK's Step 0 on a copy first.

packageRules.description: The provided and system jars (tink, scala-library, slf4j, horizon) must match what the target Horizon image ships, NOT the newest upstream release: they move with HORIZON_VERSION, never on their own. check-provided-jars.sh enforces it at image build; the system `horizon` jar's version is HORIZON_VERSION itself (-Dhorizon.version).

tink-ciphertrust is our own library (mdapi/tink-java-ciphertrust), published to that project's GitLab maven registry; the pom names no repository (ci_settings.xml does), so without this Renovate looks only on Maven Central.

GRADUATED — minor+patch (promoted by the graduation tick / Windmill f/desk/renovate_graduate). The baseline here is MR-only, so this list is the whole minor+patch automerge. Must sit above GRADUATED — major. `__none__` is a sentinel, not a package: it keeps an emptied list inert instead of matching everything.

GRADUATED — digest. Automerge a DIGEST update (same tag, rebuilt content) for the packages named here, written by the `automerge:digest` tick or label. ⚠️ PLACEMENT IS THE MECHANISM: must sit ABOVE 'DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR', whose matchJsonata reads `automerge` as resolved by the rules above it.

⛔ DEMOTED — MR-only whatever else says otherwise. Written by the `automerge:never` tick or label, which ALSO removes the package from every GRADUATED rule — the removal is what makes it bite, since GRADUATED·minor and ·major sit below this rule. ⚠️ Must sit ABOVE 'DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR': a demoted digest admitted to the shared branch would hold it open for every member.

DIGEST CHURN IS ONE MR — every digest update that automerges shares one branch. matchJsonata reads `automerge` as resolved by the rules ABOVE, which keeps MR-only digests out: a group automerges only if every member does. Must stay below every rule that sets automerge for a digest.

GRADUATED — major. Packages explicitly promoted to MAJOR automerge by the graduation tick or the automerge:major label. A major is a breaking change by definition, so only packages named here automerge one. MUST stay last: packageRules are last-match-wins, and un-graduation is a removal from these lists.
